info.title: DataSentinel API
info.description: Explainable data observability: ingestion, profiling, quality rules, schema drift, statistical anomalies, lineage impact and fault-injection experiments.

get.description: Liveness: the process is up and serving requests.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description: Readiness: the database answers, migrations are current and storage is writable.

post.description:
Import a file as a new dataset, or as the next version of ``dataset_id``.

The upload is parsed and validated, stored under a server-generated key, profiled, checked
against the dataset's enabled rules and compared with the previous version.

delete.description: Permanently delete a dataset, all of its versions, stored files, rules, results and lab data.

schema.title: Response Delete Dataset Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Delete
Response List Versions Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Versions Get
Response Delete Version Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Versions  Version Id  Delete
Response Get Import Summary Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Versions  Version Id  Summary Get

post.description: Mark a version as quarantined. Data is kept; the previous active version becomes current.

get.description: Paginated view of the parsed rows (original text values; missing values are null).
Exact column statistics for a version (defaults to the current version). Cached per version.
Catalogue of rule types with descriptions and JSON schemas for their parameters.

schema.title: Response Rule Types Api V1 Rule Types Get
Response List Rules Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Rules Get

get.description: Rules suggested from the current version's profile. Nothing is created until you POST one.

schema.title: Response Rule Suggestions Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Rules Suggestions Get
Response Delete Rule Api V1 Rules  Rule Id  Delete

post.description: Run the dataset's enabled rules (or the listed rules) against a version and store the results.

schema.title: Response List Validations Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Validations Get

get.description:
Compare two versions: schema changes, per-column statistics and explained signals.

Defaults: the candidate is the current version and the base is the newest active version before it.

schema.title: Response Get Drift Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Drift Get

get.description:
Anomalies within one version: robust outliers, daily time-series deviations and (optionally)
Isolation Forest row scores. No baseline version is needed.

schema.title: Response Get Anomalies Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Anomalies Get

get.description: Summaries of every stored comparison for the dataset, newest first.

schema.title: Response Drift History Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Drift History Get

get.description: All assets with health state and a deterministic layered layout, all edges, and any cycles.

schema.title: Response Lineage Graph Api V1 Lineage Get

post.description:
Declare a non-dataset asset (source system, transformation, report, model).

Dataset assets are created automatically when a dataset is imported.

schema.title: Response Create Asset Api V1 Lineage Assets Post
Response Update Asset Api V1 Lineage Assets  Asset Id  Patch
Response Delete Asset Api V1 Lineage Assets  Asset Id  Delete

post.description: Declare that ``source_id`` feeds ``target_id``. Rejected if it would create a cycle.

schema.title: Response Create Edge Api V1 Lineage Edges Post
Response Delete Edge Api V1 Lineage Edges  Edge Id  Delete

get.description: Assets potentially affected by any currently failing or anomalous dataset.

schema.title: Response Impact Overview Api V1 Lineage Impact Summary Get

get.description: Direct and transitive downstream impact of an asset, with evidence, classification and recommendations.

schema.title: Response Asset Impact Api V1 Lineage  Asset Id  Impact Get

get.description: An asset with its upstream and downstream dependencies, versions, failed rules and schema changes.

schema.title: Response Asset Details Api V1 Lineage  Asset Id  Get

get.description: Available faults with parameter schemas; with ``dataset_id``, also the columns each fault can target.

schema.title: Response Fault Types Api V1 Experiments Fault Types Get

post.description: Inject a fault into a copy of a version, run the same detection pipeline, and score it against ground truth.

schema.title: Response Create Api V1 Experiments Post
Response List Experiments Api V1 Experiments Get
Response Get Api V1 Experiments  Experiment Id  Get

delete.description: Delete the experiment and its generated lab data. The original dataset is untouched.

schema.title: Response Reset Api V1 Experiments  Experiment Id  Delete

post.description: Discard the generated data and re-run. Same seed → byte-identical data; new seed → new sample.

schema.title: Response Regenerate Api V1 Experiments  Experiment Id  Regenerate Post

post.description:
Generate an investigation report for a dataset version (quality, drift, anomalies, impact,
recommendations) or for a fault-injection experiment.

schema.title: Response Create Report Api V1 Reports Post
Response List Reports Api V1 Reports Get
Response Get Report Api V1 Reports  Report Id  Get
Response Delete Report Api V1 Reports  Report Id  Delete

get.description: Download the report as Markdown or JSON.
Every number on the dashboard, computed from stored results (nothing is estimated).

schema.title: Response Dashboard Api V1 Dashboard Get

get.description: Effective configuration that is safe to disclose (no connection strings or secrets).

schema.title: Response Settings View Api V1 Settings Get
Response Samples Api V1 Samples Get

post.description: Import the bundled demo datasets, their quality rules and the demo lineage graph.

schema.title: Response Load Samples Api V1 Samples Load Post

post.description: Verify database consistency and every stored file against its recorded SHA-256 (read-only).

schema.title: Response Run Integrity Api V1 Maintenance Integrity Post

post.description: Apply the retention policy now (delete expired fault-lab data).

schema.title: Response Run Retention Api V1 Maintenance Retention Post
